blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla issued a fresh ultimatum on Sunday to Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa to surrender or face an intensified manhunt. “We’ve been talking for a year. Enough talk. Surrender or face the music,” Remulla told the Inquirer in a Viber message. He warned that authorities would pursue Dela Rosa without restraint if he failed to heed the Philippine National Police deadline. “Then we pursue him with all abandon,” Remulla said when asked what would happen if the senator refused to surrender within the week, as given by PNP chief Gen.
